questions.question:
In the following question some statements are given, followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seemto be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No J is R

II. No R is C.

**Conclusions:**

I. All J are C.

II. Some R are J.

III. All C are R.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

I. No J is R

II. No R is C.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45916882a433eca916addbef09a21509e9684e35afae902a9b0b64d690f2fc00.png] 

I. All J are C - False (No definite relation given between J and C, so it can be possible only).

II. Some R are J - False (Because No R and C).

III. All C are R - False (Because No R and C).

So, None of the conclusion follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

questions.question: If 40 @ 2 # 3 = 83 and 60 @ 2 # 5 = 125, then 39 # 13 @ 5 = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Here,

**@ means ×**

**# means +**

Now,

For, 40 @ 2 # 3 = 83

⇒ 40 × 2 + 3 = 83.

For, 60 @ 2 # 5 = 125

⇒ 60 × 2 + 5 = 125.

For, **39 # 13 @ 5 = ?**

**⇒ 39 + 13 × 5 **

**= 39 + 65 = 104.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"104"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__** The symbols given in the last term is opposite form the previous Two.

So, calculate it carefully.
